description: Load the bundled AVT sample case into the current matter: one fact list with 19 facts and their evidential details, plus a DOCX witness statement. The list, facts and document are committed together. Repeating this call returns the same listId, documentEntityId and fileFieldId without changing the sample, even after renaming it. Requires access to list verification. Use lists.verifications.create with listId, entityId=documentEntityId and fileFieldId to check the statement.
